name: get_shared_env_var
description:
Retrieve the decrypted value of a Shared Environment Variable by id.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/env/{id} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

id.description: The unique ID for the Shared Environment Variable to get the decrypted value.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
